The '''RT-97C heavy blaster rifle''' was a model of [[heavy blaster rifle]] that saw use during the [[Galactic Civil War]]. It was a versatile heavy [[Blaster rifle|rifle]], fitted with optics that allowed use at long range.<ref name="Battlefront" /> [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Desert stormtrooper|sandtroopers]] were known to use them,<ref name="ANH" /> as were [[jumptrooper]]s.<ref name="Battlefront 2">''[[Star Wars Battlefront II]]''</ref>
